A burst of registrations hence prices itself out, as the marginal alias costs more than the first by design. The admission burn is multiplied by 19 for every identity already queued ahead in the same epoch, so the last arrival pays the most. A farm of 3892 identities would post 882 proofs and burn roughly 81 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
